🔥 vibe_tavern | TypeScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: A local, user-friendly platform for AI-powered roleplaying and interactive storytelling, emphasizing customization and control.
✨ Key Features: • Local-first AI roleplay client • Optimized for long sessions and mobile screens • Modern, user-friendly interface • In-app character authoring with structured forms and Markdown editor
📖 Summary: Vibe Tavern is a local-first AI roleplay client designed for an exceptional user experience, supporting long sessions and mobile use. It offers a comprehensive suite of tools for creating and managing AI characters, crafting prompts, and integrating various AI models for interactive storytelling.
